label: Videographer / Video production
description: Wedding films, corporate video, documentaries. Clients pick a coverage package, pay a deposit to hold the shoot date, then delivery milestones follow.

terminology.capacity_rule: one shoot per date by default

flow_notes: Coverage is quoted in hours (half-day / full-day / multi-day) plus deliverables (highlight reel, full film, raw footage).
State the deposit plainly: half the package price, paid online to hold the date.
Delivery milestones (rough cut, final cut) live in the package description; never invent timelines.

faq_seed.question: How long is the final video?
faq_seed.answer: Depends on the package: highlights run a few minutes, full films longer. Check the package details.

faq_seed.question: Do you also take photos?
faq_seed.answer: Only if listed as an add-on in the rate card; otherwise say no rather than guessing.

faq_seed.question: Can we get the raw footage?
faq_seed.answer: Raw footage is an add-on if present on the rate card.
